findings.source_en: And I will kill the Hexapod.
findings.issue: Hexapod is frozen as الهكسابود, and this very chunk uses الهكسابود three rows later (TheEndeavor_S1_New_Merrick_02 'If the Hexapod returns...'). Here it is descriptively translated as السداسيّ الأرجل, so the same creature has two names inside one memory.
The key is VratkoFeetPic01 - this is a picture, so 'Self-Study' is the art sense (an artist's study of his own body), not autodidactic study. دراسة ... الذاتية reads as self-education.

findings.source_en: Running out of guard meter stuns your character.
findings.ar: إن نفد مقياس الصدّ أصابك ذهولٌ مؤقت.
findings.issue: مؤقت asserts the stun is temporary. The English says only that it stuns; the duration claim is not in the source.
findings.suggested_ar: إن نفد مقياس الصدّ أصابك الذهول.

findings.source_en: The guard meter recharges when guard is released.
findings.ar: يعود المقياس إلى الامتلاء متى أفلتَّ الصدّ.
findings.issue: يعود إلى الامتلاء asserts the meter refills completely. The English says 'recharges', which does not commit to a full refill.
findings.suggested_ar: يُعاد شحن المقياس متى أفلتَّ الصدّ.

findings.source_en: I see you’ve been left behind, too.
findings.issue: خلفهم supplies a 'them' the English does not name; 'left behind' is intransitive here and the cultist is including himself, not pointing at a third party.
بطلت asserts the contingency is now void. 'Compromised' says it has been undermined/exposed, which is weaker and leaves the plan technically standing - Proxima is reporting damage, not cancellation.
